profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Forward-thinking, results-oriented cybersecurity professional with backend development experience for a large retailer. Detail-oriented problem solver with exceptional troubleshooting and communication skills. Hands-on leader experienced in all aspects of planning, coordinating, and executing a wide range of projects.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, Cybersecurity
positions.description: Skills: SQL · Object Oriented Design · Tableau · Java · Analytical Skills · Apache Spark · Software Development · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Brinqa Administrator · Jira · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Software Engineer III, Cybersecurity
positions.description: Skills: Neo4j · Object Oriented Design · Analytical Skills · Brinqa · Vulnerability Management · Splunk · Agile Methodologies · Jira · Confluence

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
•	Performed black box testing on client application as well as monitored the population of databases utilizing Toad and SQL.
•	Enabled the team to perform systematic testing of the client application by designing High-Level calendar and test cases.
•	Collaborated between multiple stakeholder teams for resolution of issues found during testing.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Performed periodic enhancements on Pega applications that were used by about 400 users of a client of IBM in finance domain, as part of a coordinated software development effort, to enhance client productivity.
•	Developed a bash script to automate repetitive manual monitoring of records which helped save time and resources of the team.

projects.title: Files and Indexing - Database Engine
projects.description:
Rudimentary database engine loosely based on MySQL; operatingentirely from the command line and implemented in Java.
It supported commands like- SHOW SCHEMAS, USE, SHOW TABLE, CREATE SCHEMA, CREATE TABLE, INSERT INTO TABLE, DROP TABLE, SELECT FROM WHERE and EXIT

projects.title: Library Management System
projects.description: Java Swing-based GUI for use by librarians, which interfaces with MySQL library database.  Incorporated use cases to search/issue/return books, create new members and manage fines for book loans.
